title: Unit Event — Kick It Up a Notch — Episode2 My Final Assignment

meta.Event Outline: Vivid BAD SQUAD is all set to perform at "Crawl Green" and are very excited about it. Kohane and the others are also looking forward to seeing Taiga there, but he happens to get a phone call which...

rows.Line: One week later
Vivid Street

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Oh, this is a great angle!
I'll try taking your photo like this.

rows.Speaker: Cranky Old Lady
rows.Line: Of course. Just promise to capture my good side, okay?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Y-Yes, I promise!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (Hehe. I think I got in some really good shots...)

rows.Speaker: Record Store Lady
rows.Line: Hm? Kohane? What are you doing here?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Oh, it's you! Hello!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I was working on my singing by going around and taking photos of the city.

rows.Speaker: Record Store Lady
rows.Line: You're working on your singing? By taking photos? Oh, this must be another one of Taiga's weird training methods...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Th-They're not weird...
Just a little different.

rows.Speaker: Cranky Old Lady
rows.Line:
So, how did it turn out?
Did you get my good side?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Yes, here! Please take a look.

rows.Speaker: Cranky Old Lady
rows.Line:
Wow...! You're good!
Would you mind giving me a copy? I'd like to send one to my grandchildren...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Of course!
I'll bring some by your store later.

rows.Speaker: Cranky Old Lady
rows.Line: Thank you very much. I really appreciate it.

rows.Speaker: Record Store Lady
rows.Line: But I feel like you have it kinda rough sometimes. I've seen you walking around speaking only foreign languages and copying animal noises before. You know you're allowed to complain to him, right?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Haha...
Actually, I think there's a purpose behind all those things.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I feel like they've given me the chance to think about how I express myself and use my imagination when singing...

rows.Speaker: Record Store Lady
rows.Line: Really? So, he's not just messing with you? Maybe I should be helping you too...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Oh, are you sure?
I thought you were about to go somewhere...

rows.Speaker: Record Store Lady
rows.Line: No, my boyfriend just said that he's gonna be running late, so I have some time on my hands now. Ask me anything! Want me to strike some poses for you?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Thank you very much! Then...

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: Hey, how's it going?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Oh, Taiga!
Can you take a look at this photo? I thought it turned out really well.

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: Hm? Let's see...

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: Yeah, you captured her smile really well. Especially considering how she has an infamous scowl.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Hehe. Thank you very much!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: For each photo, I asked the people in them to help me, and they all agreed after I mentioned that I was practicing with you, Taiga.

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: I was watching you from afar, but you seem to have been making a lot of friends around here.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Yes, I am. And it's because you've been nice enough to take me to all these different places.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I was actually a little scared of Vivid Street not too long ago...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: But I feel really comfortable here after singing with An and the others, and walking around with you.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Everyone here's so warm, friendly and really welcoming... It's really nice.

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: So, you like it here...?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Huh? Um...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Yes...
I like things here very much!

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: I see.

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: Then, as long as you do, this place should reciprocate that feeling.

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: And when it does...

rows.Speaker: Cranky Old Lady
rows.Line: I thought I heard a familiar voice just now. Hello there, Taiga.

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line:
You came out to see me...?
Glad to see that you're still doing well.

rows.Speaker: Cranky Old Lady
rows.Line:
Hmph. Don't write me off just yet.
I'm not croaking until I see you...er...WALKER stand on top of the world.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (WALKER...? Oh, that's his stage name...)

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: Haha. You listen to me too?

rows.Speaker: Cranky Old Lady
rows.Line: Don't forget that I've been watching you since you were just a kid. It's only natural for me to want to see you become a fully-fledged artist.

rows.Speaker: Cranky Old Lady
rows.Line: So, Taiga, good luck over there.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
(She really cares about him.
She's even known him since he was really young...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (I can't even begin to imagine what Taiga was like when he was little...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (I can tell that he really grew up here...)

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: Now then. Sorry for getting sidetracked, but we'll have to call our practice here.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Okay. Thank you!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I need to go practice for our event now, so if you'll excuse me!

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line:
Wait before you go...
We're finished practicing for today, but there's something I need to tell you.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Huh? Um... Tell me?

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: I was just recently asked to do a US tour... And I plan to accept their offer.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: What?! A US tour?! That's incredible...! Congratulations, Taiga!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (Things just got really big all of a sudden... He really must be an amazing singer... And he's teaching me...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
(Wait, but...
If he accepts this offer to go on tour and goes over to the US...)

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: So, I don't have much time left to practice with you and teach you things...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Yes, I see...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
B-But...!
Again, congratulations!

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: Thanks. So, as a little assessment, why don't you sing for me right now?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
What...?
You want to hear me sing...?!

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: Yeah. Anything you like. And it doesn't have to be long since your voice probably isn't warmed up.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Okay. Then...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Um... How did I do...?

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: Yeah, that told me more than enough.

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: You've improved a lot since the last time I heard you sing.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
*Gasp*
Really?!

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: I can see why that geezer at Crawl Green likes you so much. He's definitely got a good eye.

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line:
Singing's a complicated thing.
Just being good isn't enough to get through to others.

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: Which is why I wasn't teaching you to become a better singer technically. You need to possess certain more intrinsic qualities to accomplish that. Qualities that we have.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Intrinsic qualities...?

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line:
You've done well up to this point.
And you seem to have sort of realized why I had you do all those things.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
No, I still don't have the full picture...
However, this has given me a chance to rethink how I should practice.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: For example, I've become better at imagining what a song is supposed to be about and how to express what's in my mind...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: And by struggling to speak in a foreign language, I've figured out how to stop relying on lyrics and put emotion into my voice itself.

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line:
Yeah, that's right.
Everything you just mentioned is essential to singing.

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: Skills aren't actually what's “most important” when it comes to singing well or producing good music.

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: If you keep improving your understanding of how to get a clear image in your head and actually express that by singing, the sky's going to be the limit for you.

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: That along with everything else will help you figure out what's “most important”. There's more to singing than just singing.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: That reminds me of what you told me the other day...

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: Anyway, my point is that just singing isn't enough. I want you to at least take that away from this...

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: Hey, you have a good memory.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I remember because I really had no idea back then what walking around the city had to do with singing...

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: Really? But it seems like you're friends with everyone around here now...

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: Which means your next event should be a good chance...

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: Alright, I'm going to give you one last assignment. Let's call it...your final.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: My final...?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Okay.
What would you like me to do?

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: Perform by yourself during your next event.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: What...?!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: B-By myself...?! Alone...?!

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: Yeah, that's right... But I'm not telling you to leave your team or stop singing with An and the others.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Oh, okay... Thank goodness...
But... How am I supposed to do that...?

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line:
Well, for example...
Remember what Nagi did for RAD WEEKEND? You could be the opening act.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: The opening act...

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: Yeah. How you go about that is up to you, but I think you'll be able to face the audience better by performing alone since you'll have them all to yourself.

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: Also, even though I know you have some experience flying solo, performing by yourself for your own event is something else.

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: You'll find out what I mean when you take the stage.

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: But this isn't the time or place to decide whether you do it. If you are interested, you should ask your teammates about this...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: O-Okay. Thank you very much.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Me...? Performing solo during our event...?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Is it really okay for me to...?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
(Singing first means...
I'm the one setting the pace for our event. Like Nagi did for RAD WEEKEND...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (But An and Tono had to work really hard to book the venue for our event. Not only that...)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Anyway, if we do get to sing at Crawl Green, I promise to put on a performance that's going to floor everyone there.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (It's going to be an important event for Shinonome...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (Knowing all that, if I mess up...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: But...

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: I was just recently asked to do a US tour... And I plan to accept their offer.

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: So, I don't have much time left to practice with you and teach you things...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (This may be my only chance to have Taiga see me sing...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (If this really is it, then I might... No, I'll definitely regret it if I let this chance slip.)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I want to give it a try...
